comment: Unfiltered polarizing exposure set; GCN 22444 reports the telescope was pointed at 2018-02-24 22:21:44 UT, +36.2747 s relative to the precise Swift trigger=22:21:07.7253 UT (the circular rounds this to +37 s), and gives a maximum magnitude of approximately 16.7. The same set had an approximately 5σ limiting magnitude of 18.1; this is not a separate nondetection row. Exposure duration and exact midpoint are not reported, so the stated pointing time is used as the time anchor and time_err is left blank.

Swift/UVOT 3σ measurement from GCN 22454; stated T_start=61 s, T_stop=211 s, Exp=294 s. Time and time_err use the midpoint and half-width of the published T_start/T_stop interval; magnitudes are in the UVOT system (Vega) and are not corrected for Galactic extinction (E(B−V)=0.01). GCN 22442 reports the overlapping early White finding-chart result 18.94±0.15 at +160 s (150 s exposure); it may be the same early data product, but the overlapping windows and different exposure totals prevent confirming identity, so both records are retained. GCN 22454 lists 294 s exposure across a 150 s T_start/T_stop span; the published window is used for timing and this mismatch is preserved.

Swift/UVOT White finding-chart exposure: GCN 22442 says it started +85 s after BAT T0 and lasted 150 s; time is the midpoint +159.2747 s relative to the precise BAT T0=22:21:07.7253 UT (the circular gives whole-second offsets) and time_err is half the exposure. GCN 22442 does not state a magnitude system, so mag_system remains blank.

Unfiltered polarizing first exposure set; GCN 22444 gives UT=2018-02-24 22:24:12, +184.2747 s relative to the exact Swift T0=22:21:07.7253 UT (the circular rounds this to +185 s). The circular also says 176 s after trigger (about 8.3 s later than the stated +176 s, using the precise BAT trigger 22:21:07.7253). It only says the telescope was pointed and gives a first-set 5σ limit of about 15.8 mag; exposure duration and start/stop are absent, so the absolute UT pointing time is the only usable anchor and the exposure midpoint cannot be recovered. time_err remains blank.

OA-SDG 0.5m Rc upper limit from GCN 22452. The circular gives start=2018-02-24 23:33:36 UT, 9×180 s, and R>20.2; using the absolute start and half of the 1620 s total exposure gives midpoint 23:47:06 UT (time=+5158.2747 s from the precise Swift T0=22:21:07.7253 UT; MJD retained from this midpoint). The circular’s “about 1.21 hours after the trigger” is approximate and does not match the precise absolute time, so the absolute UT and exposure sequence anchor the record. The previous time=5122 s was measured from the erroneous old T0=22:21:44 UT.

AbAO/AS-32 GCN 22448 检测（原表滤光片 CR，按 Cousins R 键录为 Rc）：OT=21.88±0.15，表列 UL=22.6；表头注明 t−T0 为 midpoint (days)，按用户裁定采用表列 0.15162 d，记 time=13100 s、MJD=T0+time=58174.0829598。原文绝对 UT 起始为 2018-02-25 01:07:37，Exp=60×60 s；若假定连续曝光，估计中点为 01:37:37 UT（相对精确 Swift T0 为 +11789.2747 s），比所采用的表列中点早 1310.7253 s（约1311 s；表列中点对应 01:59:27.7253 UT）。可能由未列出的帧间间隔造成，但原文无法确认，故保留并说明差异。time_err=1800 s 为名义总曝光的一半；星等系统未在通告中明确，留空，银河系消光未校正。
